name: Pledge
fix_description: In swapTokenU, the function is public without access control. Anyone can call it to swap the contract token balance to USDT and send to an arbitrary _target address. Fix: add onlyOwner modifier.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a single-call exploit that directly drains the vulnerable contract by passing its full token balance into swapTokenU, suggesting an obvious missing validation/access control issue. It requires minimal protocol understanding, no flash loans or multi-contract orchestration, and the exploit code is extremely short.
